separation_from_f1_claims: This record is scan-quality evidence only. The pair is not a genuinely unseen F1 transfer family and is excluded from F1 generalization claims.

registration.method: 24 proper PCA-frame orientations plus four dominant-plane orientations, followed by deterministic trimmed rigid ICP
visual_pose_checks: four large circular holes overlap in plan view
top-center notch overlaps in plan view
bottom central cutout and paired lugs remain on the same side
upright flange and long one-sided return point in the same direction in the short-side profile
long-side asymmetric raised features overlap rather than swap sides

findings: The rigid overlay shows a coherent several-millimetre separation of the formed upright wall in the short-side profile; this is localized shape displacement, not uniform global pose error.
The deviation heatmap concentrates the largest residuals along the upright wall and its transition geometry while broad regions remain much closer to the good baseline.
The deviation histogram has a dense sub-millimetre mode plus a distinct long tail through roughly 8 mm, consistent with a localized formed-feature deviation rather than whole-part misregistration.
The plan and long-side views preserve asymmetric landmarks and major openings, supporting the accepted pose rather than a mirrored or reversed alignment.
native_resolution_visual_critique.limitation: No drawing/profile or bend-angle tolerance was supplied. This establishes a detectable geometric difference relative to the labeled good scan, but does not independently set a production acceptance threshold.
